cases.question: How often are database snapshots taken?

result.answer:
[1] # Backup recovery runbook — synthetic evaluation fixture
Database snapshots are taken every six hours. Snapshot retention is 35 days.
Restore requests require approval from the on-call database operator.
The recovery time objective is four hours; it is an objective rather than a contractual guarantee.
Restore drills run quarterly in an isolated staging account. Backups are encrypted with AES-256.

[2] # Privacy operations — synthetic evaluation fixture
Workspace deletion is completed within 30 days after identity verification.
Deletion from backup snapshots follows the 35-day snapshot retention period.
Data exports use CSV files and require administrator approval.
Personal data is hosted in the EU region. Audit event retention is 180 days for the Standard plan.
Legal holds suspend deletion until the hold is released by the compliance owner.

[3] # Incident response — synthetic evaluation fixture
Severity-one incidents are acknowledged within 15 minutes by the on-call engineer.
Customer status updates are posted every 30 minutes during a severity-one incident.
Postmortems are delivered within five business days after incident closure.
The incident commander owns escalation. Root-cause estimates are preliminary until the postmortem is reviewed.
